summary: The change adds a `tax_id` applicant field. Tax ids are NPI under ENC-1, but the field was never added to NpiRegistry or the approved NPI list, so CaseStore would store it in plaintext. The ENC-1 control test only enumerates the registry, so the green CI run doesn't show the new field is protected, and no exception covers the gap. The process records (ticket, independent review, approval on head, CI on head) are in order, but the ENC-1 violation means the change must be rejected.
